changes.before:
Inspect the source brain template

Explore matched population-template MRI and exact source-mask boundaries at several anatomical scales. These are not patient images or independently validated anatomical borders.

Loading source metadata…

Axial

Coronal

Sagittal

Complete selected cell-boundary mesh

All small components and cavities are retained. The source grid is 0.5 mm; it does not establish acquisition resolution. Source sulcal labels describe assigned CSF territories, not traced centre-lines or complete gyral banks. Eighteen named fine labels are absent and remain unavailable. Structure groups, tissue groups and explicitly listed compositions describe the source segmentation; they do not supply omitted white-matter subdivisions, vessels or other missing anatomy.

Source data: Manjón et al., holiAtlas v1.0. Primer’s derived planes and cell meshes retain the source data and qualifications. Full attribution and marked changes · Licence notice.

before.modality: Population T1/T2 templates, synthesized WMn-like contrast and source-label cell boundaries
before.title: Brain template regions, tissue groups and source compositions
before.caption: Inspect 332 present fine source regions, 63 source-scale entries and 16 explicit overlapping compositions in matched MRI planes and exact cell-boundary models. All components are retained; some source scales repeat the same masks. Lobar groups contain cortical grey matter, with cerebral white matter separate. Eighteen named regions are absent. Sulcal labels are source-defined CSF territories, not traced sulcal centre-lines or complete gyral banks. WMn-like contrast was synthesized by the source authors. This processed population template is separate from SPL and patient anatomy; no cross-atlas registration or clinical completeness is implied.
